problem: The local adapter persisted a peer read receipt only in the reader owner copy; reopening the sender history omitted that receipt.
change: Update existing message copies for the same chat in one memory-state mutation; retain each copy identity, mine flag, message order and unread counts of other owners.

validation.reproduction: 15 existing checks passed; the new regression failed before the repair.
validation.result: 16 checks pass after repair, including receipt persistence for both copies, idempotent repeat reads, reader-only counter changes and unchanged message IDs.

efficiency.externalIO: No HTTP, Mongo or additional IndexedDB operation. Existing caller flush is retained.
efficiency.copying: Message byId map copied once only when a receipt changes; chat-owner copies found once per changing batch; existing per-message upsert/sort removed.
efficiency.complexity: One owner scan and one message-map copy, then direct map lookups for each changed message/owner. No repeated persistence or per-message ordering.

limits: Focused local frontend regression proof; not a new matched stress result.
Backend application, HTTP/WebSocket chat behavior and deployment composition were unchanged by this repair.
Template browser qualification is tracked separately.
